_comment: Ember V2 expression table. Each clip animates one reference panel (rig.json) with animate.py. loop = frames at fps; every periodic term completes whole cycles per loop. motion keys: flow_base/flow_tip (px of flame turbulence at the root/tips), flow_tiles (tiles scrolled per loop, one per noise octave), sway_px, bob_px/bob_cycles/hop, tilt_deg/tilt_osc, smoke, flicker, bright, spark_rise/spark_cycles (painted sparks), sparks (extra procedural), handles (hand puppet offsets). face keys: lid (0 open .. 1 closed), lid_tilt (+ worried, - stern), gaze [dx, dy] px, eye_scale, mouth {src panel, at [x, y], scale, open} and talk (mouth open cycles per loop). blink: lid levels for the runtime blink overlay; omitted = no blink (smiling or closed eyes).

frame._comment: V2.1: a square of `side` panel pixels centred on the panel. The companion host draws the cell at presence scale 0.5/0.42 and fades it to a disc ending at its box, so the box shows side/1.19 = 540 panel px: the whole painting composition, feet and crest inside the disc. V2 was side 490 around the neck with the feet at 0.955 (feet and crest cut by the disc).

stage._comment: Transparency-ready (owner directive 'URI UI V2 compatibility', 2026-10-15): no opaque backdrop. The clips' V2 aura pool is off (strength 0); light from the flames is a translucent emissive glow (export_v2.Framing.glow, alpha <= 0.45), fading before the cell border. Fidelity cost and choice: evidence/fidelity/P3_RESULTS.md. V2.1's painted opaque backdrop (9933ca2b) was: texture, pool [5, 6], edge 0.04, strength 1.0.

fierce.reference: 03. FIERCE (rendered and scored; not mapped to any operational state)

stage._comment: Depleted only: the painted backdrop as a 60 % translucent haze (P3: smoke reads 73.8 without it, 79.0 with it); still transparent (alpha <= 0.29 outside the central circle; transparency_gates.json).
